title: Tamizhukku En Ondrai Azhuthavum
desc: A tech-savvy person is given a task to fix the mobile connection of an entire city, unaware that the completion of it could activate a bomb explosion.

title: Lover
desc: Arun and Divya have been dating for six years. However, their relationship goes through a rough patch when insecurities and possessiveness creep in.

title: Netrikann
desc: Being the prime witness, a former policewoman who cannot see must unveil a horrific case of serial abduction where the culprit has unleashed a reign of terror in the city of Chennai.

title: Engeyum Eppothum
desc: Amudha, a village girl visiting Chennai for the first time, falls in love with Gautham, a stranger, who shows her around the city. Kathiresan, a metal worker, is infatuated by Manimegalai, a nurse.

title: Vacha Kuri Thappaathu
desc: Karthik, a businessman, gets married to a rich woman, to increase his wealth. However, things change, when he falls in love with an environmental activist, who files a suit against his company.

title: Chithha
desc: Living a quiet life with his niece, Eeswaran manages to provide for her and nurtures her like a parent. However, his journey takes an insidious turn when she goes missing.

title: Vinveli 9000
desc: Dev, a retired astronaut, attempts to repair a faulty satellite in outer space. If he is unable to fix the problem, it can lead to a blackout across the world.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Pathukavalan
desc: A bodyguard is assigned to protect Keerthi, the daughter of Naidu. Problems arise when the bodyguard develops feelings for an anonymous lady admirer, unaware that it is Keerthi.

title: Kadaisi Ulaga Por
desc: In the year 2028, a power struggle on an international level creates political turmoil in India. Thamizh, a common man, rises to the occasion to save the day.

title: Paramporul
desc: Aadhi along with a police officer, Maithreyan, embark on a mission to smuggle temple idols in order to make quick money.

title: It'S My Life - Seetha
desc: A young Ram is left in a monastery by his uncle with a promise that Sita will come for him and take care of him. Years later, he is ecstatic when he meets Sita.

title: Idharkuthane Aasaipattai Balakumara
desc: An idle youngster causes chaos in the life of a disciplined banker, whose struggles with his demanding boss are further complicated by the youth's carefree attitude.

title: Sivanudukkai
desc: A boy becomes an atheist after his parents' death. Unbeknown to him, he is born for a divine purpose and must stop a demon from sacrificing his lover.

title: Ungalukkaga Oruvan
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to reconcile with a former classmate. Upon discovering his companion's dire predicament, he intervenes and becomes a heroic saviour for the entire community.
